description.value:
After the Achilles hit the market, Militech decided to try improving upon near perfection by remedying some of its minor flaws while adding so many new features that it would be the only weapon an army would ever need. Thermal imaging, integrated 40mm launcher, larger magazine, and more efficient conductors. Yet, the end product was far more complex and costly than many consumers — especially militias not used to maintaining advanced weaponry — were willing to pay. If you do get your hands on one, read the manual, because you’ll never want it to break on you.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Supercharger, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Tech Rebuild cannot see through Thin Cover. It can still fire through Thin Cover, but requires some other method by the user to see through Cover to fire at valid targets. This weapon’s Tech Rebuild only requires sacrificing half of the user’s MOVE (round down) to be charged. This must be done before the user has used any MOVE in their Turn [Supercharger]. This weapon is considered Super Luxury for the purposes of Tech Upgrades, Repairs, and Maintenance.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Supercharger, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
